title: Docker over the socket
description: State, health and restarts of the containers from the Docker API (read only), optionally their output into the logs. Whoever may use the socket is root: the host has to allow it with allow_docker_socket = true in agent.toml (also for Podman, containerd, CRI-O and other runtimes).

socket.title: Socket
socket.description: The API socket of Docker or Podman, below module_sockets.

max_containers.title: Most containers
max_containers.description: Containers reported, the running ones first.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Per request to the API, at most 25s.

logs.title: Container logs
logs.description: Names of containers whose output goes to the logs, * as a wildcard (e.g. web, app-*); at most 16 containers are followed. Empty: no logs.
